title: MIG-COW: Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Deepfake Detectors via Gradient Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.30914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite recent advances, deepfake detectors remain vulnerable to adversarial examples, particularly in diverse, real-world settings. We propose MIG-COW, a novel adversarial attack framework that generates highly generalizable and visually imperceptible adversarial examples. By combining momentum-integrated gradients with a consensus-orthogonal decomposition, MIG-COW captures both shared and model-specific vulnerabilities across heterogeneous CNN and ViT detectors. On the AADD-2025 Challenge benchmarks, MIG-COW achieves a 99.96% white-box attack success rate (ASR) with high perceptual similarity (SSIM), significantly outperforming existing baselines. However, its limited 7.16% ASR against official black-box targets - despite achieving the best overall score - highlights the ongoing challenge of transferability. translated_title: MIG-COW：基于梯度分解的深度伪造检测器可迁移对抗攻击
translated_abstract: 尽管近期取得了诸多进展，深度伪造检测器仍然容易受到对抗样本的攻击，尤其是在多样化、真实世界的场景中。我们提出了MIG-COW，一种新颖的对抗攻击框架，能够生成高度泛化且视觉上不可察觉的对抗样本。通过将动量积分梯度与共识正交分解相结合，MIG-COW能够同时捕获异构CNN和ViT检测器中共享的以及模型特有的漏洞。在AADD-2025挑战赛基准测试中，MIG-COW实现了99.96%的白盒攻击成功率（ASR），同时保持了高感知相似度（SSIM），显著优于现有基线方法。然而，尽管获得了最佳综合评分，其对官方黑盒目标仅7.16%的有限攻击成功率凸显了可迁移性方面仍然存在的挑战。我们还证明，在集成中加入性能较低但多样化的模型可能会降低攻击效果。
tldr: MIG-COW通过将动量积分梯度与共识正交分解相结合，捕获CNN与ViT检测器的共享及特有漏洞，在AADD-2025挑战赛中实现了99.96%的白盒攻击成功率并显著优于现有基线，同时揭示了黑盒可迁移性仍是待解决的挑战。
en_tdlr: MIG-COW achieves a 99.96% white-box attack success rate on deepfake detectors by combining momentum-integrated gradients with consensus-orthogonal decomposition to capture shared and model-specific vulnerabilities across CNN and ViT detectors, while highlighting that black-box transferability remains an open challenge.
